description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-based specialty coffee chain with dozens of locations across the province. This Main Street location sits on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors near East 26th, offering espresso drinks, nitro coffee, whole-leaf teas, and a food menu that includes sandwiches, wraps, and baked goods. Cyclists passing through the Main Street bike route will find it a practical stop for hot or cold drinks and grab-and-go food.
